name: eu4-save-mcp
description: Chat with your Europa Universalis IV campaign: Claude reads your save files and gives strategic insights.
long_description: Reads EU4 save files (plaintext, compressed and — with the free rakaly CLI — ironman) on Windows, macOS and Linux, and exposes your campaign to Claude: country overview, economy breakdown, military, diplomacy, wars, provinces, world rankings, history trends, save-to-save progress and an automatic health check with concrete advice. Read-only: it never modifies your saves.

save_dir.title: EU4 save folder (optional)
save_dir.description: Leave empty to auto-detect (Documents/Paradox Interactive/Europa Universalis IV/save games and Steam Cloud).

rakaly_path.title: rakaly executable (optional)
rakaly_path.description: Only needed for ironman/binary saves. Download from https://github.com/rakaly/cli/releases.

tools.name: eu4_environment
tools.description: Detect OS, save folders, game version and rakaly.

tools.name: eu4_list_saves
tools.description: List save files with date, country and version.

tools.name: eu4_load_save
tools.description: Load a save and summarise the campaign.

tools.name: eu4_military
tools.description: Armies, navies, manpower and enemy comparison.

prompts.name: campaign_review
prompts.description: Full strategic review of the latest save.
prompts.text: Load my latest EU4 save with eu4_load_save, run eu4_find_problems, then review economy, military and diplomacy. Focus: ${arguments.focus}
